## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` — build, tooling, or repo hygiene
- [ ] `refactor` — code restructure with no behaviour change
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `test` — adding or updating tests

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] The PR is narrowly scoped to one concern
- [ ] New public symbols have doc-comments
- [ ] Relevant tests are added or updated
- [ ] The [QA Matrix](../Docs/qa-matrix.md) is updated if acceptance criteria changed
- [ ] No new third-party dependencies are introduced without prior discussion
- [ ] I have verified the change manually (or explained why manual verification is not applicable)
